skills.name: Fura
skills.description: Attacks with strong wind magic. Bad effects on enemies.  *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -30% (10 sec) *ATK x 3000% Area Damage  *Enemy knockback

skills.name: Clairvoyance
skills.description: Shares vision with aligned beings. Good effects on allies.  *Cancels continuous damage  *Move Speed +170% (7 sec) *ATK +270% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Re:ZERO
abilities.description: Re:ZERO Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Knockback: Intelligence
abilities.description: Has a high chance of knocking back all Intelligence type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
